name: subagent-ceiling
description: demo-lead has budget.maxDelegatedAgents: 2 -- a pooled ceiling on the TOTAL number of sessions in its delegation tree, counting the root. demo-lead first delegates to demo-coder, its only roster member: before that call the tree has 1 member (the root alone), so the child brings it to exactly 2, at but not over the ceiling, and the SubagentRequest controller must allow it -- the delegation must reach the model as a real, non-error tool result whose content IS the child's return_result, not a scripted reply that merely describes success. demo-lead then delegates to demo-coder a second time: the tree already has 2 members (root + first child), so a third would exceed the ceiling, and the SubagentRequest controller must deny it BEFORE creating a second child -- there is no second child turn to script, mirroring subagent-delegation's off-roster denial. The refusal must reach the model as an error naming the ceiling (2), not a generic failure and not a success the transcript merely narrates as a refusal. A ceiling of 1 would only ever prove the denial; this value proves both directions in one run.
